distributionChannels.label: Best Of
distributionChannels.description: A best-of card for every legend released to date, 49 in all, including new over-number art for the four Proving Grounds legends. The Chinese counterpart of the western Regional Championship best-of. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=1614s))

distributionChannels.label: Nexus Night
distributionChannels.description: Weekly store event. Three-card pack: 18 commons and uncommons, three per domain; six runes at about one pack in six; and a chase at about one in 80. Called Rune Night in China. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=613s))

distributionChannels.label: Origins
distributionChannels.description: Announced [2025-10-06](https://riftbound.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/news/announcements/riftbounds-first-english-regional-qualifier-and-other-op-updates/). "This is open format, store play, every week. Show up and throw down with your friends (and rivals) in 1v1’s, 2v2’s, and 3 & 4-person FFA’s. All participants will receive an Origins Promo pack, every week!"

distributionChannels.label: Spiritforged
distributionChannels.description: The Spiritforged pack also carried 16 Proving Grounds reprints, which shared the foil slot and made the set-2 runes scarcer than the set-1 ones. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=289s))

distributionChannels.label: Unleashed
distributionChannels.description: The Unleashed pack reprinted the Spiritforged rune art under UNL codes, which made that art easier to get. First set where the chase card differs between China and the west. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=633s))

distributionChannels.label: Vendetta
distributionChannels.description: First set where the chase card is the same in China and the west. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=1363s))

distributionChannels.label: Pre Rift Event
distributionChannels.description: Pre-rift kit promo. The pre-rift window falls at different times in China and the west, and creators running western pre-rift events have the promos in hand before release. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=442s))

distributionChannels.label: Radiance
distributionChannels.description: Announced [2026-09-25](https://playriftbound.com/en-us/news/announcements/the-radiance-overview/). The pool grew to 24 cards, four per domain: two commons, an uncommon and a rare. Six alt-art runes by Jincheng Guo and the chase card Lulu, Whimsical (RAD-110a).

distributionChannels.label: Unleashed
distributionChannels.description: Announced [2026-03-16](https://riftbound.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/news/announcements/the-unleashed-overview/). "Sign up for your LGS’s Pre-Rift event and get your copy of Ashe, while supplies last!" 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-07.

distributionChannels.label: Launch Event (Origins)
distributionChannels.description: Announced [2025-07-19](https://riftbound.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/news/announcements/riftbound-at-events-in-2025/). "This promo card will be used for the remainder of our events outside of China for 2025, and will be replaced with a new promotional card for 2026." In China it went out at conventions and pre-release events alongside the demo Teemo. The Korean release Jinx also sits on this channel, across a range of Korean launch events. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=69s))

distributionChannels.label: Radiance
distributionChannels.description: Announced [2026-09-25](https://playriftbound.com/en-us/news/announcements/the-radiance-overview/). "Sign up for your LGS’s Pre-Rift event and get your copy of Heimerdinger, Academy Instructor while supplies last!" 2026-10-16 to 2026-10-22.

distributionChannels.label: Ask a Rioter
distributionChannels.description: Only obtainable from Riot staff members. Usually handed out for something someone did for the community. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=189s))

distributionChannels.label: Learn To Play Store Demo
distributionChannels.description: Announced [2025-10-06](https://riftbound.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/news/announcements/riftbounds-first-english-regional-qualifier-and-other-op-updates/). "All over the world, people are learning to play Riftbound at their local game store with the help of our teaching kits. Check with your LGS to see if they’re running demos. Limited Promos have been provided to stores for those who participate in these demos - swing by and get yours while supplies last! " In China the same promo also went out at conventions and events, alongside the launch-exclusive Ahri, rather than at stores only. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=73s))

distributionChannels.label: Paris TFT Open
distributionChannels.description: Event 2025-12-12 to 2025-12-14 in Paris Expo Porte de Versailles. Handed out to anyone who played a demo or a sealed event, with no announcement beforehand. Still the only French promo. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=247s))

distributionChannels.label: Local Game Store Promo
distributionChannels.description: Announced [2026-03-31](https://riftbound.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/news/announcements/flash-promos-and-origins-reprint-updates/). Bulk allocation to local game stores to give away on whatever terms they like: demos, purchases, turning up. It exists so nobody has to buy Proving Grounds for a Flash. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=518s))

distributionChannels.label: Origins Judge
distributionChannels.description: Announced [2025-10-06](https://riftbound.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/news/announcements/riftbounds-first-english-regional-qualifier-and-other-op-updates/). "Every job deserves a reward, our first is a special Heimerdinger, Inventor Judge Promo Card. Once Judges adjudicate their first event (and it’s logged in the Judge Center), UVS will mail them the Heimerdinger (foil) promo." In practice it has mostly reached judges who worked a regional qualifier, Houston judges receiving two each. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=228s))

distributionChannels.label: Spiritforged Judge
distributionChannels.description: Awarded to judges at tournaments in the Spiritforged season. Riot says anyone who judged a local event during set 2 will receive one, but so far it has mostly reached judges who worked a set-2 regional qualifier. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=404s))

distributionChannels.label: Unleashed Judge
distributionChannels.description: Awarded to judges at tournaments in the Unleashed season. So far it has only reached judges who worked a set-3 regional qualifier or, in China, a regional open. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=882s))

distributionChannels.label: Vendetta Judge
distributionChannels.description: Awarded to judges at tournaments in the Vendetta season.

distributionChannels.label: Release Event
distributionChannels.description: Release-event promos, called regional open practice events in China. China later reused the slot for a launch-celebration tournament prize in sets 2 and 3, awarded for winning rather than attending. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=73s))

distributionChannels.label: Origins
distributionChannels.description: The Origins release events, called regional open practice events in China. The two-card pack handed out here also carried the three Origins-stamped starter-deck champions. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=73s))

distributionChannels.label: Spiritforged
distributionChannels.description: Chinese-only prize for winning a Spiritforged launch-celebration tournament at a local game store. Khasino's May round-up calls it the pre-rift win reward and the August one the launch-celebration prize; the two may describe the same event. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=270s))

distributionChannels.label: Unleashed
distributionChannels.description: Chinese-only prize for winning an Unleashed launch-celebration tournament at a local game store, the set-3 answer to the Spiritforged Jace. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=461s))

distributionChannels.label: City Challenge
distributionChannels.description: Chinese only event. The Chinese counterpart of the Summoner Skirmish. Set 1 ran one card per month; set 2 moved to two cards per half-season, participation and champion, where the west ran three; from Unleashed both regions run three per half. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=710s)) The Traditional Chinese regions run it too, starting with their own Origins season in 2026.

distributionChannels.label: August 2026 (Traditional Chinese)
distributionChannels.description: First half of the Traditional Chinese Origins season, 2026-08-29 to 2026-09-13. Top 8 prize.

distributionChannels.label: September 2026 (Traditional Chinese)
distributionChannels.description: Second half of the Traditional Chinese Origins season, 2026-09-19 to 2026-10-11. Top 8 prize.

distributionChannels.label: Summoner Skirmish
distributionChannels.description: The western store tournament series. Unlike the Chinese City Challenge, both cards of a season could be had at the same event. Set 1 ran two cards; set 2 moved to three per half, participation, top 8 and champion; Unleashed brought China to the same three. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=710s))

distributionChannels.label: Origins
distributionChannels.description: Announced [2025-10-06](https://riftbound.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/news/announcements/riftbounds-first-english-regional-qualifier-and-other-op-updates/). "These are a series of competitive game nights that occur twice per set. For Origins you’ll see them pop up between Nov 24th-Dec 28th and between Dec 29th-Feb 1st. At Summoner Skirmish, players can battle to earn prizes and first round bye’s at the next Regional Qualifiers they attend." Both events (Nov 24 and Dec 29, 2025) had the same promos. Korea ran its own set-1 store qualifiers from 2026-09, awarding top 32 and champion cards.

distributionChannels.label: Prize Wall
distributionChannels.description: First come, first serve. Plated legends cost 10 prize tickets at Houston and 40 afterwards. The set-1 and Proving Grounds plated legends stay available for three sets and retire once the Vendetta qualifiers begin in Barcelona. Houston's wall carried all 16 of them and no other cards; the oversized battlefields and the rune collection came in later seasons. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=247s), [RQ Houston prize wall](https://uvsgames.com/rq-houston-prizewall/))

distributionChannels.label: Best Of
distributionChannels.description: One holographic metal card per legend, awarded to the highest-placing competitor piloting that legend regardless of final placement, so one copy per legend per event. A one of one until the next qualifier hands them out again. Sixteen cards covering Origins and Proving Grounds. Best-of legends run the same three-set window as the plated ones: awarded at every qualifier from Houston through Hartford, then retired when the Vendetta season opened in Barcelona. The Chinese run was announced for the Shanghai Nationals. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=189s), [May](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o5WusHqChH4&t=789s))

distributionChannels.label: Prize Wall
distributionChannels.description: Oversized battlefields at one prize ticket each, with a single side-event win paying a ticket. Plated legends at 40 tickets, limited to one per attendee per weekend, across all four set-2 qualifiers (Bologna, Las Vegas, Lille, Atlanta). Each of those walls carried 28 plated: the twelve Spiritforged legends plus the sixteen Origins and Proving Grounds ones still inside their three-set window. The Spiritforged twelve stay available through the Vendetta season on the same rule. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=404s), [RQ Bologna](https://uvsgames.com/rqbolognaprizewall/), [RQ Atlanta](https://uvsgames.com/rq-atlanta-prize-wall/))

distributionChannels.description: One holographic metal card per legend, awarded to the highest-placing competitor piloting that legend regardless of final placement, so one copy per legend per event. A one of one until the next qualifier hands them out again. Announced [2026-02-16](https://playriftbound.com/en-us/news/announcements/eyes-on-bologna-what-to-know/): "28 total Best-Of Legends spanning Riftbound: Origins, Proving Grounds, and Spiritforged." The same 28 ran at all four set-2 qualifiers. Best-of legends stay available for three full sets, which is why the sixteen from Origins and Proving Grounds are still awarded here alongside the twelve Spiritforged ones.

Rune supply was short: absent at Sydney, debuted at Vancouver, stuck in customs for Utrecht and back at Hartford, so only two of the four events had them. ([Khasino 2026-08](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A7i-6Ey88uA&t=997s), [RQ Sydney](https://uvsgames.com/rq-sydney-prize-wall/), [RQ Vancouver](https://uvsgames.com/rq-vancouver-prize-wall/), [RQ Utrecht](https://uvsgames.com/rq-utrecht-prize-wall/), [RQ Hartford](https://uvsgames.com/rq-hartford-prize-wall/))

distributionChannels.label: TFT Global Finals (China)
distributionChannels.description: Chinese-exclusive Teamfight Tactics crossover promo. The card is branded 英雄联盟 · 云顶之弈 · 金铲铲之战 on the front and carries the 全球总决赛 (Global Finals) logo on the back, tying it to the 金铲铲之战 2025 全球总决赛 ([Oct 14 – Nov 13 2025](https://jcc.qq.com/act/a20250930competition/index.html)). Handed out at the Chinese offline TFT events of that season — sellers list it as the "Choncc's Lucky Park" (胖胖龙好运乐园) promo, matching the card's own flavour attribution; the 成都 胖胖龙好运乐园 水友赛 ran 2025-11-04 – 2025-11-13. First reported [2025-11-04 by Riftbound Report](https://x.com/RiftboundReport/status/1985845611417960619). Exact hand-out mechanism unconfirmed.
